messages:
maria_ks: quick check — saw a telemetry log that included `Authorization` header values from the gateway. Is that expected?

jason_h: yikes, link?

maria_ks: paste snippet:
```
INFO request received path=/v1/generate headers={"Authorization":"Bearer sk-xxxx...","Content-Type":"application/json"} body={"prompt":"user secret data: SSN: 123-45-6789","max_tokens":64}
```

anika_r: Not expected. Gateway should redact `Authorization` and any keys that match PII pattern. Which service emitted this?

maria_ks: rproxy (redwood-proxy) ingress logging. It logs request headers for debug downstream.

jason_h: rproxy config has `log_headers: true` in prod? That shouldn't be on. @anika_r can we check config and mask rules.

anika_r: I'll check. We should add header filter for `Authorization|Api-Key|X-.*-Token` and a body scrubber for common PII (SSN, credit card, 16-digit, email?). Suggest using regex replace to mask groups.

kevin_s: Also check prompt ingestion pipeline — we still store raw prompts in prompt-store for evals; need opt-out and retention. For now, mask in logs only.

maria_ks: Proposed fix (quick patch to rproxy conf):
```
log_headers: true
header_mask_patterns:
  - "Authorization"
  - "Api-Key"
  - "^X-.*-Token$"
body_mask_patterns:
  - "(\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})"   # SSN
  - "(\b\d{12,19}\b)"      # CC-ish
mask_replacement: "[REDACTED]"
```

anika_r: That looks fine as an emergency mitigation. Also add apply_mask=true to structured logger before emitting.

jason_h: Can someone open a quick PR? Tagging @kevin_s for prompt-store retention review.

kevin_s: Opening PR now, will include tests and a migration to turn off raw prompt logging by default. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rproxy/pull/421

eng-oncall-bot: Deploy started for rproxy/us-east-1 by jenkins-ci (build 2026-02-14_17-43) :rocket:

maria_ks: Thanks — after deploy please confirm sample logs show header masked. Also need security review for prompt retention changes.

anika_r: Will review the PR and sign-off if tests pass. Quick question — do we have a SLO for no tokens in logs? Where's the policy?

jason_h: Security policy in docs -> /security/logging-redaction.md but it's out of date. Filing a docs task.

maria_ks: Filed ticket SEC-1243 to update policy and add periodic scans. Anyone else affected ping here.

kevin_s: I'll coordinate with product on evals opt-out. Will post timeline in the ticket.

maria_ks: Great :thumbsup:
